title: Suspicious PowerShell & Script Block Investigation Playbook
institution: Splunk Security Content / Microsoft Sysmon Guidance
scope: Operational endpoint investigation workflow for suspicious PowerShell execution (T1059.001), Event ID 4104 script blocks, and Sysmon process lineage.

source.document_title: Splunk Security Content Playbooks & Microsoft PowerShell Logging Guidance

prerequisites.requirement: Sysmon Event ID 1 / Windows Event 4688 and PowerShell Operational Event ID 4104 enabled
prerequisites.required_capability: Endpoint EDR and SIEM Script Block Logging

steps.activity: Validate process lineage and parent-child execution chain
steps.description: Inspect parent process image, command-line switches (-EncodedCommand, -NoProfile, -WindowStyle Hidden), and executing user context.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Inspect parent process, command-line arguments, and user privilege context.

steps.activity: Deobfuscate PowerShell ScriptBlockText (Event ID 4104) and AMSI buffers
steps.description: Decode Base64/Gzip payloads and inspect script block commands for download cradles, reflective injection, or credential access.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Script block logging records the full content of code blocks as they are executed.

steps.activity: Hunt network connections and dropped file artifacts across host telemetry
steps.description: Correlate outbound C2 IP/domain connections (Sysmon Event 3) and file creation hashes (Sysmon Event 11).

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Correlate child processes, network connections, and file modifications.

steps.activity: Quarantine endpoint and terminate malicious process tree
steps.description: Isolate host via EDR when script block analysis confirms malicious payload execution or C2 beacon.
steps.condition: When script block performs malicious download, credential access, or lateral movement.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Isolate the endpoint and terminate suspicious processes if malicious activity is confirmed.

steps.activity: Verify administrative change authorization or record incident closure
steps.description: Confirm legitimate IT administration ticket or complete incident escalation documentation.

source_anchor.quoted_excerpt: Document administrative verification or escalate confirmed incident.

completion_criteria: Event 4104 script block decoded and analyzed

normalization.method: Structured extraction from Splunk Security Content & Microsoft PowerShell Event 4104 guidance
notes: Normalized to Action Schema to enable multi-playbook PowerShell conformance comparison alongside PB-PSH-001.
